policy: Every telephony endpoint and command/event family this repository names in source must be declared here. Canonical entries must exist in the pinned calling-contract authority. Legacy entries must be absent from that authority and must carry a reason and a tracking reference, so divergence from the authority is reviewed debt rather than silent drift.

endpoints.reason: codestra_vicidial_crm pins click-to-call to the pre-canonical origination route. The authority replaces it with a command envelope posted to /v1/telephony/commands carrying telephony.call.originate.v1. Migration is deliberately staged so the reviewed unknown-outcome reconciliation and idempotency behaviour move intact.
Canonical command envelope that supersedes the legacy origination route.
Authoritative operation status used to resolve unknown command outcomes.
Governed cancellation of an accepted telephony operation.
Reconciliation path for operations whose outcome was never observed.
Realtime session ticket acquisition preceding the authenticated /ws/agent stream.

command_families.name: telephony.call.originate.v1
command_families.reason: Canonical replacement for the legacy click-to-call origination request.

command_families.name: telephony.call.cancel.v1
command_families.reason: Cancel an in-flight call the agent workspace originated.

command_families.name: telephony.call.transfer.v1
command_families.reason: Governed warm or cold transfer from the agent workspace.

command_families.name: telephony.agent.login.v1
command_families.reason: Establishes the agent desktop telephony session so later call commands carry an authoritative agent identity.

command_families.name: telephony.agent.ready.v1
command_families.reason: Moves the agent to available so the dialer may offer calls, replacing direct VICIdial state writes.

command_families.name: telephony.agent.pause.v1
command_families.reason: Pauses the agent under a governed pause code that workforce reporting can attribute.

command_families.name: telephony.agent.logout.v1
command_families.reason: Tears the agent session down so no orphaned desktop session keeps receiving offered calls.

event_families.name: telephony.call.ringing.v1
event_families.reason: Drives the Odoo screen pop for an offered call, replacing the assigned-agent Odoo Bus projection.

event_families.name: telephony.call.answered.v1
event_families.reason: Marks the offered call as answered so the CRM timeline and talk-time reporting start from authority.

event_families.name: telephony.call.connected.v1
event_families.reason: Media path established between agent and customer.

event_families.name: telephony.call.transferred.v1
event_families.reason: Records a transfer so ownership and the CRM timeline follow the call to its new agent or queue.

event_families.name: telephony.call.completed.v1
event_families.reason: Terminal call outcome with CDR reference.

event_families.name: telephony.call.missed.v1
event_families.reason: Records an offered call that was never answered, which callback and retry policy both depend on.

event_families.name: telephony.call.dispositioned.v1
event_families.reason: Carries the authoritative disposition back to the CRM lead and compliance evidence.

event_families.name: telephony.agent.status-changed.v1
event_families.reason: Agent state transition observed by supervisor views.
